#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fuzz as F

fails = 0
def check(name, cfg, ops):
    global fails
    problems = F.check(cfg, ops)
    if problems:
        print("FAIL", name)
        for p in problems: print("  ", p[:500]); fails += 1
    else:
        print("OK", name)

# deep tree (16 edges) evaluated on short flows
def chain(depth, feat):
    if depth == 16:
        return {"class": depth}
    return {"feature": feat, "threshold": -depth, "le": chain(depth+1, feat), "gt": {"class": 99}}
cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":100,"packet_limit":100,"prefix_width":32,
       "rules":[],"fallback":chain(0,31)}
ops=[{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0},
     {"op":"close","flow":0,"time":1},
     {"op":"open","flow":1,"time":2},
     {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":3,"source":1,"length":40}]},
     {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":4,"source":0,"length":40}]},
     {"op":"close","flow":1,"time":5}]
check("deep tree", cfg, ops)

# ranges spanning zero
cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":100,"packet_limit":100,"prefix_width":2,
       "rules":[{"id":1,"class":5,"priority":1,"ranges":[[-5,5],[-5,5]]},
                {"id":2,"class":6,"priority":1,"ranges":[[0,0]]}],
       "fallback":{"class":9}}
ops=[{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0},
     {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":0,"time":i+1,"source":i%2,"length":3} for i in range(4)]},
     {"op":"close","flow":0,"time":9}]
check("zero-spanning ranges", cfg, ops)

# many flows expiring at the same instant -> ascending id order
cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":5,"packet_limit":100,"prefix_width":1,
       "rules":[],"fallback":{"class":4}}
ops=[{"op":"open","flow":30,"time":0},{"op":"open","flow":7,"time":0},
     {"op":"open","flow":200,"time":0},{"op":"open","flow":3,"time":0},
     {"op":"tick","time":6}]
check("simultaneous idle ordering", cfg, ops)

# expiry interleaved inside one chunk, mid-chunk
cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":2,"packet_limit":100,"prefix_width":1,
       "rules":[{"id":1,"class":5,"priority":1,"ranges":[[4,4]]}],"fallback":{"class":4}}
ops=[{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0},{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},
     {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":0,"time":1,"source":0,"length":4},
                              {"flow":1,"time":2,"source":0,"length":9},
                              {"flow":0,"time":5,"source":0,"length":4},
                              {"flow":1,"time":5,"source":0,"length":4}]},
     {"op":"close","flow":0,"time":6},{"op":"close","flow":1,"time":6}]
check("mid-chunk expiry", cfg, ops)

# same-time open of a flow that then expires at close time
cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":0,"packet_limit":100,"prefix_width":1,
       "rules":[],"fallback":{"class":4}}
ops=[{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":5},{"op":"close","flow":0,"time":6}]
check("timeout 0 at close", cfg, ops)
ops=[{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":5},{"op":"close","flow":0,"time":5}]
check("timeout 0 same time", cfg, ops)

# negative feature direction with fallback thresholds
cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":100,"packet_limit":1,"prefix_width":3,
       "rules":[],"fallback":{"feature":2,"threshold":-3,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}}
ops=[{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0},
     {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":0,"time":1,"source":1,"length":5}]},
     {"op":"close","flow":0,"time":2}]
check("negative first feature", cfg, ops)

# rules with identical ranges and equal priority/length -> smallest id
cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":100,"packet_limit":100,"prefix_width":1,
       "rules":[{"id":100,"class":1,"priority":0,"ranges":[[1,10]]},
                {"id":50,"class":2,"priority":0,"ranges":[[1,10]]},
                {"id":75,"class":3,"priority":0,"ranges":[[1,10]]}],
       "fallback":{"class":9}}
ops=[{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0},
     {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":0,"time":1,"source":0,"length":5}]},
     {"op":"close","flow":0,"time":2}]
check("tie smallest id", cfg, ops)
print("failures:", fails)
PYEOF
